_description: Where the vendored inputs were copied from, and which inputs they are. Nothing in the pipeline reads the roots: only pipeline/vendor_inputs.py does, and only when assembling the released dataset from its sources. Users of the dataset download 00_inputs/ and 01_models/ and do not need this file.
_why_this_is_not_in_the_code: Source locations are a property of one filesystem; the input SET is a property of the method. Keeping them apart is what lets tests/test_no_absolute_paths.py stay absolute about absolute paths, and what makes it obvious that these six roots are the whole of the pipeline's external surface.
_roots_are_placeholders: The roots below ship as <PLACEHOLDER>: they describe one site's directory layout, which is site configuration rather than method. To re-assemble the dataset, put the real values in vendor_sources.local.json beside this file. It is gitignored, holds only a 'roots' key, and is merged over these by vendor_inputs._load_spec(). An unresolved placeholder stops the run with a message naming the file.

cohort._note: The knees to vendor. Defined as every knee with a completed anatomical reconstruction in the primary Step-1 run, minus the exclusions. Resolved once and written to 00_inputs/cohort.json so every later stage reads a list rather than re-deriving one.

_gaits_note: The measured gait donors whose inputs are vendored. The list matches comak_knee_oa.cohorts.MEASURED_DEFAULT. The v2 run used RSubject_121 as its ninth donor in place of Subject_121; RSubject_121 is not the participant the donor-selection design chose.

reference_tree._note: Subtrees of the requirements root to vendor, mirrored verbatim into 00_inputs/reference so nothing downstream has to learn a new layout.

_excluded.deprecated: older mesh and wrap-surface snapshots, not read by any code
_excluded.data/opencap_data: a different study's markerless capture data; not read by this pipeline
_excluded.data/stanford_gait_retraining_data: vendored selectively under 00_inputs/gait -- the per-gait AddBiomechanics results are needed, the source archives and the MATLAB workspace are not

gait_tree._note: Measured-gait inputs, per gait donor. multigait_bases holds the body-scaled generic model each cohort is built onto; addbiomechanics holds the marker trajectories, ground reaction forces and the marker-matched model the scale factor is derived from.

model_tree._note: Per-knee Step-1 output to vendor into 01_models. The COMAK results subdirectory of the same source tree is NOT vendored here: simulations are stage 02 and are run by the pipeline, not copied.
model_tree._not_yet_vendored: Run this group last, after the source tree's geometry is de-duplicated. Before de-duplication each knee carries three byte-identical copies of the same geometry directory, of which one is used, plus ~150 generic display meshes shared by every knee: ~270 MB per knee against ~6 MB after, so vendoring first would copy roughly 200 GB of duplicates.
model_tree._layout_is_mirrored_deliberately: The destination mirrors the source directory names, long and repetitive as they are, so each vendored file maps to its source path by name and renaming stays a separate step from copying.

simulation_tree._note: The reference-gait arm's COMAK output. The nine measured-gait cohorts are written into 02_simulations by the pipeline itself and need no vendoring; the reference arm was produced in a separate results tree and is copied in here, so the stage holds all ten conditions.
simulation_tree._destination_is_not_declared_here: The destination comes from config/reference_gait.json's run.results_dir, read at plan time, so the place this stage writes to cannot drift from the place every derivation (e.g. derive_figure2_data.py) reads from. A mismatch would surface only as ordinary 'simulation did not complete' rows.
simulation_tree._coverage_vs_missing: A knee with no results directory at all is a defect: the condition was never attempted for it. A knee whose directory exists but holds no joint_mechanics.h5 is a simulation that did not converge -- legitimate, reported as coverage. Same distinction the shape fits draw between a missing baseline and a missed follow-up visit.
simulation_tree._geometry_cleanup: Not run on this cohort: each knee has one Geometry directory, so there was nothing to de-duplicate.

group_labels._note: Disease-group assignment for the cohort: healthy, mild OA, and incident OA, 252 knees each. Copied verbatim; group-comparison analyses read this vendored file.
